splits: Reuse spatial-pilot draws: 180 fit / 60 validation / 120 test, balanced official subsets.
intervention: F is 4x4 or 4x4x4 pooled standardized input; PF averages F to 2x4 or 2x2x2 and repeats it onto F.

qsm.register: fine native geometry; 4 uploads; native window; local-Z readout

pairing: Within family/dataset/seed, F and PF copy initial weights and use the same deterministic minibatch order.
classical: Logistic C=1 and RBF SVC C=1; StandardScaler fit on fitting data only; RBF gamma grid logspace(-3,3)/features selected on validation.
primary: paired test balanced accuracy BA(F) - BA(PF), reported separately by dataset and family.
feature_probe: QSM local-Z at initialization and after fitting; standardized C=1 logistic fit on fitting data only.
stopping_rule: Exactly 20 epochs; no test-dependent candidate, schedule, or threshold changes.
